workAttendance.title: Attendance
workAttendance.description: Check in and out, see your month, and review corrections made by your manager or HR.

today.title: Today
today.weeklyOff: Today is your weekly off. If you worked, ask HR or your manager to record it.
today.selfDisabled: Self check-in is turned off by your organisation's policy. Ask HR or your manager to record your attendance.
today.notCheckedIn: You have not checked in yet. Check-in after {time} counts as late.
today.needsReview: Short day: it was marked as a half day and flagged for your manager to review.
today.checkInClosed: Check-in closed at {time} IST. Ask HR or your manager to record your attendance.
today.lateNow: You are {duration} late. Office time started at {time}.
today.meetingJoinedAt: You pressed the meeting button at {time}.
today.lateJoinNote: The usual check-in time ({time}) is over. You can still check in, but you must give a reason and HR is told.

people.pick: Choose an employee to see their month and correct a record.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.emptyBody: When a manager or HR corrects an attendance record, the old value, new value and reason appear here.

correct.title: Correct attendance: {name}, {date}
correct.description: The previous value, your name and the reason are kept permanently and the employee is notified.
correct.timeHint: India time. Leave empty if not applicable.
correct.reasonHint: Required. Shown to the employee and kept in the audit trail.

daySheet.title: Day sheet
daySheet.description: Check-in after {late} counts as late. Work after {end} is recorded as overtime.
daySheet.empty: Nobody to show for this day.

lateJoin.title: Joining late
lateJoin.description: It is after the usual check-in time. Tell HR why you are joining late. HR and the Boss are told.
lateJoin.descriptionLate: You are {duration} late. Tell HR why you are joining late. HR and the Boss are told.

dayReport.title: Today's work report
dayReport.description: Before you check out, tell us how much of today's work is done. HR sees this every day.
dayReport.noteBad: Add a short note on what is pending

workHolidays.title: Holidays
workHolidays.description: Approved holidays are days off for everyone: they do not count as leave, absence or Earned Leave days.
workHolidays.suggestNone: No new suggestions: they already exist
workHolidays.suggestionNote: Suggested holidays do not count as days off until you approve them. Moveable festivals must be added by hand.
workHolidays.emptyBody: HR adds the company calendar here. Until then every working day counts.
workHolidays.deleteBody: Days already closed keep their records. The change is logged with the previous values.

form.title: Add holiday
form.description: HR-entered holidays are approved immediately and change the working calendar.
form.name: Name
form.kindHint: Optional and restricted holidays are not days off unless the policy says so.
form.locationHint: Leave empty for the whole organisation.
